title: jmri-json-signalHead-client-message
description: Schema data object in message from client to JMRI for type "signalHead"

userName.description: If present, set the user name of the signalHead

comment.description: If present, set the comment for the signalHead; null clears it

state.description: If present, set the appearance of the signalHead, or 256 to hold it

lit.description: If present, set whether the signalHead is lit

held.description: If present, set whether the signalHead is held
